# EL-SYS Controls & Engineering Ltd

> Ugandan engineering company (incorporated 2022, based in Kampala, serving all of Uganda) that cuts energy costs, retrofits and automates machines, and installs safe, smart electrical systems for businesses, factories, institutions and homes. Its TiS (Turnkey Industrial Solutions) initiative supplies genuine industrial parts and makes parts locally.

- Website: https://el-sysce.com/
- WhatsApp / phone: +256 701 475 685
- Email: info@el-sysce.com
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 8:00 to 18:00; site visits by appointment
- Coverage: Kampala and all of Uganda; East Africa by arrangement
- Led by Joseph Bwamiki, electrical systems engineer (BEng Electrical & Electronics Engineering, Diploma in Mechanical Engineering), over ten years in RF, electro-mechanical and mission-critical power systems, PLC programming, CAD design and technical training.

## Services

- [Energy Management](https://el-sysce.com/#services): energy audits and load measurement, power-factor and tariff checks, scheduling, metering and savings plans.
- [Retrofitting Legacy Machines](https://el-sysce.com/#services): modern drives, sensors, PLC controls and safety interlocks for old but mechanically sound machines, instead of buying new.
- [Industrial Automation](https://el-sysce.com/#services): PLC, HMI and SCADA systems; pumping, process and warehouse automation; control panel design and building.
- [Smart Controls](https://el-sysce.com/#services): smart homes, offices and shops; automatic switching, timers, remote monitoring and alerts.
- [Electrical Installations](https://el-sysce.com/#services): commercial and residential wiring, distribution boards and protection, inspections, fault-finding and upgrades.
- [TiS: Turnkey Industrial Solutions](https://el-sysce.com/tis.html): genuine industrial parts (sourced from certified vendors or their authorised representatives), fabrication from CAD files, drawings or a photo, 3D printing, and custom part design.

## How it works

1. Describe the problem on WhatsApp, by phone or the website form; photos speed things up.
2. Site visit by appointment: inspect, measure and listen.
3. Written scope, quote and timeline before any work starts.
4. Installation, testing, documentation, handover and ongoing support.

## Industries

Manufacturing; food and beverage; water and pumping; commercial buildings; schools and institutions; homes.

## Common questions

- [FAQ](https://el-sysce.com/#faq): replacing vs retrofitting machines, coverage, quotes, energy savings, downtime, maintenance, local part fabrication, hours.
